item.title: How to Use useReducer in React
item.description: Managing complex state with multiple actions and transitions can become unwieldy with useState. As the creator of CoreUI, I use useReducer for sophisticated state management in complex UI components. The useReducer hook provides predictable state updates through a reducer function, similar to Redux but built into React.
